ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Andrew Yule & Company Limited, a Government of India Enterprise, has formally intimated the appointment of M/s. Nag & Associates as its Statutory Auditors for the financial year 2026-27. This appointment was mandated and executed by the Comptroller and Auditor General of India, reflecting a standard governance practice for Public Sector Undertakings in India. Nag & Associates is a well-established firm with over 46 years of continuous practice and relevant experience, indicating a routine and compliant auditor selection process with no apparent red flags.
